title: "Task 3: Build and Train a Neural Network"
author: Daniel Nickolov
output: pdf_document
---


## Objectives

* Build and train a neural network
* Find a model that performs at least as well as the PC logistic regression from task 1
* Quantify the predictive accuracy

## Setup

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(keras3)
```

## Load data and partition

```{r data}
load('../data/claims-clean-example.RData')

set.seed(110122)
partitions <- claims_clean %>%
  initial_split(prop = 0.8)

train_text <- training(partitions) %>%
  pull(text_clean)
train_labels <- training(partitions) %>%
  pull(bclass) %>%
  as.numeric() - 1

test_text <- testing(partitions) %>%
  pull(text_clean)
test_labels <- testing(partitions) %>%
  pull(bclass) %>%
  as.numeric() - 1
```

## Preprocess Layer

```{r preprocess}
preprocess_layer <- layer_text_vectorization(
  standardize = NULL,
  split = 'whitespace',
  ngrams = NULL,
  max_tokens = NULL,
  output_mode = 'tf_idf'
)

preprocess_layer %>% adapt(train_text)
```

## NN Architecture

```{r architecture}
inputs <- layer_input(shape = 1, dtype = 'string')

outputs <- inputs %>%
  preprocess_layer() %>%
  layer_dropout(0.2) %>%
  layer_dense(units = 25, activation = 'relu') %>%
  layer_dropout(0.2) %>%
  layer_dense(1, activation = 'sigmoid')

model <- keras_model(inputs, outputs)

summary(model)
```

## Training the model

```{r train}
# configure for training
model %>% compile(
  loss = 'binary_crossentropy',
  optimizer = 'adam',
  metrics = 'binary_accuracy'
)

# train
history <- model %>%
  fit(train_text,
      train_labels,
      validation_split = 0.3,
      epochs = 5)

plot(history)
```


## Checking Test Set Accuracy

```{r test}
evaluate(model, test_text, test_labels)

# predictions and confusion matrix
test_probs <- predict(model, test_text) %>% as.numeric()

test_results <- tibble(
  truth = factor(test_labels, levels = c(0, 1)),
  pred = factor(as.numeric(test_probs > 0.5), levels = c(0, 1))
)

accuracy(test_results, truth = truth, estimate = pred)
conf_mat(test_results, truth = truth, estimate = pred)
```

Comparing this to our accuracy in preliminary task 1 of about 77.38%, we notice a close to 5% improvement in prediction accuracy running the neural network over the PC logistic regression, getting about 0.82% accuracy here.

## Save model

```{r save, eval=FALSE}
save_model(model, '../results/task3-model.keras')
```
